title: LM Studio runner errors
description: The LM Studio runner's own error codes, beyond the runner contract's. They fill the contract's runnerErrors extension point. Each refuses run/start, so no run is acknowledged.

oneOf.description: The run/start options hold a key the runner doesn't define, such as endpoint or model, which come from the run's runtime.
An option's value has the wrong shape. The fix names what is valid.
The run/start names no runtime, or one whose model is empty, so the runner has no service to talk to. The fix says what to give the actor or its runtime.
The runtime's endpoint is https, which LM Studio's library can't connect to, or has a path, where LM Studio's own API lives at the server's root. The fix gives the endpoint to use.
The runtime has a credential, which LM Studio's library has no way to send. The problem names the variable, never the value.
run/start says the runtime has no credential, yet TROUPE_RUNTIME_CREDENTIAL is set in the runner's environment. The problem names the variable, never the value.
Nothing at the runtime's endpoint answered as LM Studio within the runner's time limit, or it answered with a redirect, which isn't followed.

LM Studio answered its greeting, but its library couldn't list the downloaded models: an LM Studio older than the one the runner was tested with, or one that's changed. The fix names the tested version from the runner's published requirements.
No model LM Studio has downloaded has the run's model as its key. The fix names the lms get that downloads it.
The run's model isn't an LLM, or LM Studio doesn't mark it as trained for tool use.

where.description: Where the problem is, such as options.maxTurns or runtime.
